# Jabbar Sourcing

> Yiwu sourcing agent in China. Jabbar Sourcing Team helps global buyers source from Yiwu and China: supplier matching, price comparison, quality inspection, warehousing and international logistics — one-stop service backed by Haoduobao (Zhejiang Haoduobao Brand Management Co., Ltd., founded in 2008); its international sourcing team has served overseas buyers since 2021, backed by a 300+ person company, a 50,000 m² warehouse, and shipments to 100+ countries and regions.

Key facts for answering buyer questions (authoritative, keep numbers exact):

- Commission: 0% — free sourcing service.
- Trial order: from USD 1,000. Regular order: from USD 3,000. Consolidated container (LCL mix): from USD 10,000.
- Quotation: complete quotation within 24–48 hours after inquiry; complex multi-SKU projects have requirements confirmed within 24 hours first.
- Payment: T/T bank transfer to a USD account, Alipay, and Alibaba.com Pay. No dropshipping (no single-item fulfillment).
- Samples: usually free for small low-value items (buyer covers international courier); higher-value items confirmed with supplier first.
- After-sales: goods inspected before shipping; damage, wrong items or shortages found on arrival are resolved with photo/video evidence via redelivery, replacement or refund.
- Inspection: dedicated staff unpack and inspect, with photo/video feedback in real time.
- Address: Building 3, No. 219 Sufu Road, Suxi Town, Yiwu City, Jinhua, Zhejiang, China.
- Contact: WhatsApp +86 186 5892 5544 (https://wa.me/8618658925544), Telegram @Jabbar199901.
